title: Look-alike radicals
intro:
Four pairs of radicals look nearly identical but mean different things. Mixing them up is the most common handwriting mistake at this stage, so this unit drills the differences directly.

Pair 1: 氵 water (three dots) vs 冫 ice (two dots). 冫 means ice or cold. Count the dots.

字PinyinMeaningWords
冷lěngcold冷水 cold water; 很冷 very cold
冰bīngice冰水 ice water; 冰箱 fridge
冬dōngwinter冬天 winter (two dots at the bottom)
凉liángcool凉快 pleasantly cool
决juédecide决定 decide
次cìtime (occurrence)第一次 the first time

Pair 2: 礻 spirit (one dot, 4 strokes) vs 衤 clothing (two dots, 5 strokes). 礻 comes from 示 (altar): rituals, blessings, gods. 衤 comes from 衣 (clothing).

礻 spiritPinyinMeaning衤 clothingPinyinMeaning
礼lǐgift, ritual衬chènlining (衬衫 shirt)
祝zhùwish衫shānshirt
福fúblessing裤kùtrousers
神shéngod, spirit袜wàsock
社shèsociety被bèiquilt; (passive marker)
视shìlook at初chūbeginning (cloth + knife: the first cut)

Pair 3: 日 sun (tall) vs 曰 say (wide and flat). 曰 is the classical word for "to say." It appears inside 最 zuì (most), 曾 céng (once, formerly) and 替 tì (replace). Write 曰 wider than it is tall.

Pair 4: 月 moon vs 月 flesh. They look the same in modern writing. On the left with a body meaning, it is flesh: 脸 liǎn (face), 脚 jiǎo (foot), 腿 tuǐ (leg), 胖 pàng (fat), 肚 dù (belly), 脑 nǎo (brain). With a time meaning, it is the moon: 期 qī (period, as in 星期), 明 míng.

Sentences to copy by hand

  1. 今天很冷，外面都结冰了。 It's cold today; it's frozen outside.
  2. 祝你生日快乐，天天幸福！ Happy birthday; I wish you happiness every day!
  3. 我买了一件衬衫和一条裤子。 I bought a shirt and a pair of trousers.
  4. 这是我最喜欢的电视节目。 This is my favorite TV show.
  5. 你的脸怎么红了？ Why has your face gone red?
  6. 这是我第一次来中国。 This is my first time in China.
  7. 我走了一天，腿和脚都很疼。 I walked all day; my legs and feet hurt.

Unit 17 test (closed book, handwritten)

A. Write the character: 1. cold 2. ice 3. winter 4. decide 5. gift 6. wish 7. blessing 8. shirt (two characters) 9. trousers 10. sock 11. face 12. foot 13. leg 14. most

B. Write 礻 or 衤 to complete each character, then write the full character: ?+彡 shān (shirt) · ?+畐 fú (blessing) · ?+库 kù (trousers) · ?+兄 zhù (wish) · ?+末 wà (sock) · ?+乚 lǐ (gift)

C. Write 氵 or 冫 to complete each character: ?+令 lěng (cold) · ?+又 hàn (Chinese) · ?+京 liáng (cool) · ?+可 hé (river) · ?+夬 jué (decide) · ?+东 dòng (freeze)

D. Translate into Chinese characters:

  1. It's very cold today.
  2. I wish you happiness.
  3. This shirt is too big.
  4. My feet hurt.
  5. This is my first time in China.

Answer key

A: 冷 冰 冬 决 礼 祝 福 衬衫 裤 袜 脸 脚 腿 最. B: 衤 衫 · 礻 福 · 衤 裤 · 礻 祝 · 衤 袜 · 礻 礼. C: 冫 冷 · 氵 汉 · 冫 凉 · 氵 河 · 冫 决 · 冫 冻. D: 今天很冷。 / 祝你幸福。 / 这件衬衫太大了。 / 我的脚很疼。 / 这是我第一次来中国。

exercises.why: 泠 (líng) has three dots (氵); cold has two (冫)
杉 (fir) has 木; shirt has 衤
副 has 刂; blessing has 礻
欠 is missing the two ice dots
库 is only the sound part
快 has 忄; decide has 冫
